build_online_feature_extractor: build an OnlineFeatureExtractor to extract Kaldi Fbank speech features from audio samples on the fly
create_tensor_list_entry: create a TensorListEntry to store and concatenate a list of PyTorch tensors with append and info methods
run_fairseq_simul_st_agent: run a FairseqSimulSTAgent to perform simultaneous speech-to-text translation using a pretrained Fairseq model
review_policy_method: review the FairseqSimulSTAgent policy method to decide between READ_ACTION and WRITE_ACTION for latency control
test_predict_method: test the FairseqSimulSTAgent predict method to get the next token index from decoder output probabilities
